Many Trials, Dungeons and Arenas have synergies related to a specific encounter/mechanic/area Sigils are a type of synergy available in certain Arenas and Battlegrounds by activating the glowing token during combat. In Imperial City Prison , during the battle with Ibomez the Flesh Sculptor , he will drop flesh grenades, which can be activated like a Synergy to deal Disease Damage to the enemies in the room. In the Cradle of Shadows , there are Flesh Atronachs with torches which can be looted from them with a Synergy when they are killed.  Doing so will protect you and your group from the darkness in the later sections. At Shipwreck Cove on Vvardenfell , Kimbrudhil the Songbird has an attack which will Levitate all nearby players, and most likely kill them.  The only reliable way to escape this is with a Synergy called Escape her Embrace . In Bastion Nymic , killing a Nightmare creates an area where you can activate the ​ Fissure synergy to passively get "Fissure", which has the following description: "You stepped into a liminal space between this realm and another. Things otherwise hidden may reveal themselves to you." This reveals the dark potents for the Nightmare's Puzzler achievement, and the Vaermina's Nightmares during The Dreadful Herald 's fight. Sometimes, there are other events which behave like Synergies, giving you the option to perform an action during combat.  They are activated in the same way, but do not require another player to be around, or trigger any abilities which are affected by Synergies.  Some examples are: The Blade of Woe ability can be used by sneaking close enough to a humanoid target as long as you have the relevant Dark Brotherhood passive skill. It instantly kills weak humanoids and is therefore useful for murdering Justice Neutral NPCs. The range is slightly lower than a vampire's Feed ability. The Feed ability shows when you are a Vampire and sneaking close enough to a humanoid target to feed.  Doing so will increase your Vampirism Stage by one, as well as restoring your Health .  Your Vampirism stage will decrease every 6 hours if you do not feed. Some of the Vampire abilities are only available or become more powerful if you are in the higher Stages of Vampirism. Doing so is considered an attack, and will be reported as a crime if done to a non-hostile enemy. The range is slightly higher than the Blade of Woe ability.  The same ability shows when giving another player a bite at a Vampire Shrine with the Blood Ritual skill, though this does not affect your Vampirism stage. The Insatiable Hunger ability can be used by Werewolves provided they have invested in the skill line and are currently in Werewolf form. This allows you to consume the corpses of your slain enemies to restore your Health and gain Ultimate . The same ability shows when giving another player a bite at a Werewolf Ritual Sites with the Shadow of the Bloodmoon skill. The Slaughter synergy can be used by Werewolves while they are prowling on targets they have snuck behind, much like with the Blade of Woe and Vampire Feed abilities. During the final battle in Arx Corinium against Sellistrix the Lamia Queen , the Nereid sisters will give you the option to " Taunt Her! ", causing Sellistrix to direct her attacks at the Nereid instead of you.  This is part of the Force of Nature quest and thus will only be available on your first run-through of the dungeon. During Stone Cold , you have to Use Indanas to Collapse Hole . During the quest God of Schemes , there are two instances where you are given a pseudo-Synergy event, first to form floating rocks into a bridge using Aedric Command , and later to escape from Molag Bal's clenched fist using Sacrifice of Courage . If you rescue Unsulag during the Forcing the Faith quest in Paragon's Remembrance , she will cast a healing spell which gives you a Synergy called Restoring Waves which restores your health. When Scruut is following you, she will periodically give you the Apocrypha's Wrath synergy to use, which summons Scruut's Tentacle to assist you. During Kynreeve Ryl 's fight, this synergy also stops his "Ryl's Nightmare" ability. During some parts in Necrom 's main quests after recovering Meln the Mouthless , you can use the Ghost Sight synergy against spirit-like enemies which have dramatic damage taken reduction. Dealing damage to those enemies grants you a stack of "Ghost Sight" for 30 seconds, and at 3 stacks a small area appears on the ground which grants you the Ghost Light synergy. Activating this synergy greatly increases your damage done for a time and causes the spirit-like enemies to immediately change back into their physical form. After defeating Vaermina's Nightmare in The Mythos , you will use the Black Book: The Tormented Eye synergy twice to fire a beam at Vaermina herself. During Chronicle of Fate , you will have to use Meln's Ghost Sight to reveal a passage.
